blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Recife.

Transfer to the airport. Flight to Recife. Transfer to your hotel in Porto de Galinhas. Time for rest. The town is located in the south of the state, 60 km from the city of Recife. The town is known for its magnificent beaches, some of the most beautiful in the country. Clear turquoise water, clean white sand and palm trees on the shore give a unique flavor to this old colonial town.

Hotel Nannai Muro Alto, Double Bungalow with sea view, HB

The centre of Porto de Galinhas is livelier. Muro Alto is protected by a long reef, so the water behind it is calmer. At low tide, you can see the pale seabed and small fish.

There are cafés and shops in the resort centre. At low tide, **jangadas**, the local flat-bottomed boats, leave the shore for the natural pools among the reefs.
